resources.string: The integrated terminal sets up a Linux environment inside the app\'s private storage: shell, package manager and updated repository — usable as soon as the install completes.
About 40 MB to download for the base environment. A network connection is required.
Linux shell, package manager and CodeIDE repository — installed mandatorily, the repository is updated (apt update) at the end.
JDK (openjdk-17), git… — optional for the first setup: installable right after the environment, or later when the features that need them prompt you.
Optional — offered after the base environment is installed.
Installation cancelled. You can restart it at any time.
The shell, the package manager and the updated repository are ready — the terminal is usable right away.
Development tools (JDK, git) are required to sync and build Gradle projects.
Network unavailable. Check your connection, then retry.
Not enough storage space (about 1 GB free required). Free up space, then retry.
Invalid downloaded archive. Retry — if it persists, a new bootstrap version will be published.
The app\'s private storage refused an operation. Restart the app, then retry.
Package configuration failed. The log below shows the last failing output — retry, the installation restarts from scratch, harmlessly.
Tool installation failed. The base environment remains installed and the terminal stays usable — retry, the log below shows the last failing output.
An embedded tool binary is missing from the app. A CodeIDE update will be required.
This device\'s architecture is not supported by the bootstrap yet (arm64 required).
